name: Latte & Mocha
author: CatVinci-Studio
description: Soft pastels for long sessions: a cool latte page by day and a deep mocha one at night, mauve accents, lavender quotes and a sapphire bold. An unofficial port of the Catppuccin palette.

zh.description: 适合长时间写作的柔和粉彩：白天是清爽的拿铁色，夜里是深摩卡色，淡紫点缀，薰衣草色引用，粗体为宝石蓝。Catppuccin 配色的非官方移植。
